title: The Field Where Arithmetic Dissolved Into Wind

features.name: breath-that-stopped-counting
features.desc-on-touch: You feel the wind that learned not to measure. It passes through you with no need for numbers.

features.name: grasses-learning-to-forget
features.desc-on-touch: Tall grasses bend without counting their stems. They sway in patterns that have no equation.

features.name: the-sky-that-opens-upward
features.desc-on-touch: Above, the sky holds no measure. It opens endlessly, indifferent to quantities.

features.name: the-measure-fallen-away
features.desc-on-touch: A rod lies in the grass, unused. Numbers were written here once. Now the marks are fading into rust.

inscription: where the wind counted nothing and everything became possible

file.name: Field_Notes_Where_Numbers_Learned_Rest.txt
file.note: Observations on open country where arithmetic becomes unnecessary. The paddock records its own measurement by refusing to be measured.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the paddock where you both stopped counting
narr: You stand together in the open field, and she stops
mid-sentence. Not with urgency, not with doubt. She
simply stops reaching for the next number. The grass
goes on swaying without counting its blades. Your heart
does not know the exact measure of its beats. And yet
you both are here, real as stone, real as wind.
